description: APPLICATION FOR A LAWFUL DEVELOPMENT CERTIFICATE IN RESPECT OF THE PROPOSED ERECTION OF A HIP TO GABLE, REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION AND 2 FRONT ROOFLIGHTS
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a hip to gable and rear roof extension and x1 side window at roof level would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class B of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class B. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Condition : 2 - The insertion of x2 rooflights to front roofslope would consist of any other alteration to the roof of the dwelling house within the meaning of Class C of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class C. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Condition : 3 - INFORMATIVE
The applicant should be aware that the site may provide a useful habitat for swifts. Swifts are currently in decline in the UK and in order to encourage and improve the conservation of swifts the applicant is advised to consider the installation of swift nesting box/bricks on site.

Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE: The applicant is advised that side windows proposed in the development must be fitted with obscure glazing and shall be non-opening below a height of 1.7 metres above the finished floor level of the room in which the window is installed, in order to comply with the requirements of A.3 (b), Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the GPDO 2015 (as amended).

Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE
Building Regulations 
Please note that this is a planning consent only and you may also require approval under the Building Regulations. If you are in any doubt about this you can get further information via https://www.merton.gov.uk/planning-and-buildings/building-control  or by emailing building.control@merton.gov.uk.
